X.action: Attack (tap: fast combo strikes; hold: charged Omega Attack using Magick)

Y.action: Special (tap: weapon special; hold: charged Omega Special using Magick)

B.action: Cast (tap: throw Magic Circle to ensnare/damage enemies; hold: charged Omega Cast)

A.action: Dash (tap: short dodge-dash; hold: sprint at full speed)

right_bumper.action: Interact (talk to NPCs, pick up items, open doors/chests)

disputed.left_trigger: Fextralife wiki lists this as 'Gift' (give keepsake/items to NPCs), but a Game8 guide instead lists Gift on right_trigger (which conflicts with Call/Hex also being on right_trigger), so the exact default button is unclear.
disputed.left_bumper: Fextralife wiki lists this as 'Open Codex', but another Game8 guide lists left_bumper as 'Tab Left' (menu navigation) and 'Salute' with Codex/Inventory instead tied to D-pad directions, so the true default binding is unclear.
disputed.back: Fextralife wiki lists this as 'Boon Info', but another Game8 guide instead maps Boon Info to D-pad Left, so which is the actual default is unclear.

source.note: Primary source read directly for default PC keyboard/mouse and Xbox controller bindings; core combat bindings (movement, Attack/X, Special/Y, Cast/B, Dash/A, Interact/RB, Call-Hex/RT) were cross-checked and confirmed against https://www.shacknews.com/article/146103/hades-2-controls-pc-keybindings and https://game8.co/games/Hades-2/archives/453563, which agreed. Non-combat bindings (Gift, Codex, Boon Info) disagreed between sources and are listed under 'disputed' rather than guessed. Note: the device-name vocabulary provided has no entry for mouse buttons, so the keyboard+mouse scheme (which binds Attack/Cast to mouse buttons) could not be fully represented; the Xbox controller scheme was used instead since it maps completely onto named buttons.
